verdict.rationale: Phaser Studio documents official AI tooling. The hosted Game Agent builds games from plain-language prompts ("What game do you want me to make?", "Give the player a double-jump..."). The editor page describes AI handling scene tasks such as creating particle emitters, reorganising layers and renaming objects "without switching tools." An official MCP server with 40+ tools also drives these tasks from external agents. It is only partial because the evidence for an assistant embedded in the editor is a single thin marketing line, and much of the capability is delivered through a hosted agent or external MCP clients rather than inside the engine. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an in-editor assistant UI, evidence of answering API questions, asset scaffolding detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
